comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a robot-gripper opening stop, then verifies retained motion; PR-1941 fills and removes a vacuum blood tube while keeping a venipuncture needle stable.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires concentric driver/wrench seating, countertorque and locknut tightening; PR-1941 requires stabilizing a needle holder while pushing and pulling a tube.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a retained 90° setting, three repeatable cycles, lock retention and released clearance; PR-1941 requires tube filling and removal without needle displacement, followed by released tray placement.
comparison.reason: Needle stabilization during tube exchange does not test preserving an adjustable screw setting against jam-nut reaction; all material rubric details are present.
